text:
zoe: fyi @product — got a fed contractor asking for Dedicated capacity in their gov cloud. SLA 99.99% required, peak bursts up to 4x baseline during 09:00-17:00 ET. they want sizing + timeline. customer willing to sign reserved commit.

sanjay: adding to intake. can you paste usage profile and any latency targets? model types?

zoe: usage quick paste: avg 200 concurrent chats, avg response ~800 tokens, 95th response ~1200 tokens. models: 13B conv model + reranker. target latencies: p50 <250ms, p95 <500ms. auth/KMS required.

ella: quick back-of-envelope for throughput: if baseline sustained throughput ~6k tok/s and spikes to 24k tok/s during business hours, rough GPU pool suggestion:
```
baseline: 4 x A100-80GB
burst: autoscale up to 12 x A100-80GB
kv-cache nodes: 2 small VMs for prefix cache
expected p95 at baseline: ~350-450ms (depends on batching)
```
this is a rough starting point — need real perf numbers.

matt: note on gov cloud procurement: dedicated nodes lead time 6-10 weeks for hardware + regional approvals. autoscaling across AZs is restricted for gov tenancy. for 99.99% SLA we should provision warm spare nodes and pre-warm burst capacity.

lucy: support checklist: they require audit logs streamed to their SIEM + KMS integration + role-based access. add to backlog.

sanjay: ok priority = high (sales-opportunity). proposing acceptance criteria: 1) 99.99% uptime on Dedicated, 2) p95 latency <500ms at baseline, 3) graceful degradation (auto-fallback to smaller model variant or hosted API) under sustained overload, 4) KMS + audit logs present, 5) canary rollouts and rollback controls. agree/disagree?

ella: +1 to criteria but would prefer p95 <400ms target if engineering can deliver. also require documented autoscale policy: scale step size, cool-down, and max burst limit.

zoe: :thumbsup: sales asks for an 8-week run-to-close timeline. is that realistic?

matt: realistic timeline: if we order hardware: 6-10w lead + 3-4w integration = 9-14w. if we can reallocate existing Dedicated capacity in the region and reuse infra configs, we can compress to 3-6w but requires approvals from capacity planning and legal for gov tenancy.

sanjay: action items: 1) eng-platform (ella) to draft sizing + cost estimate and run a micro-benchmark on similar models (+3d). 2) security/compliance to enumerate KMS/audit requirements (+5d). 3) product to create formal intake ticket and push to priority backlog (today). 4) sales (zoe) to confirm exact region, contract term, and commit window (today).

ops-bot: Ticket created: PROD-1438 — 'Fed contractor Dedicated capacity intake' — assigned to sanjay, priority: P1

zoe: thanks, will update customer and loop back with region + reserved term by EOD tomorrow.
